description: Receipt-confirmed application metrics for a window of UTC days: confirmations, their daily and rolling 30-day counts, and the rolling interview rate; internal AI spend is left out. Reads only.

days.description: How many UTC days back to count, ending today.

name: get_metrics

confirmed_count.description: Applications confirmed by a receipt inside the window.

confirmed_per_day.description: Confirmed applications per day across the window.

daily_confirmed.description: Confirmed applications by UTC date inside the window.

days.description: How many UTC days back the window counts.

rolling_30d_confirmed.description: Applications confirmed in the last 30 days.

rolling_30d_interview_rate.description: Interviews per confirmed application over those 30 days, or null when nothing was confirmed.

rolling_30d_interviews.description: Applications that reached interview or offer in the last 30 days.

uncertain_count.description: Applications sent without a confirmed receipt, account-wide now.

title: Read application metrics
